audit.whatIsWrong: The stage whys were the generic Lux template and described Lux winning stages the chart awards to Akshan.
audit.why: Akshan's early edge is Dirty Fighting's extra shot and Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1, 800 range) letting him trade and leave before Q lands; Going Rogue falls to 6s by rank 4, so the roam threat, not the duel, prices Lux's shove.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 8/10 stands early; whys for Levels 1 through 4-5 now name Dirty Fighting, Heroic Swing and Going Rogue with real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on three rows: phases[4-6].side all read 'Akshan' while content win[4]='Skill', win[5]='Lux', win[6]='Lux'.
audit.why: Lux wins 55.11% over 1633 games, and both layers' prose (spikes[2], spikes[3], late, phases[6].why) says Lux takes over from first item — Akshan is squishy and terrain-dependent between swings.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side to Skill, phases[5].side and phases[6].side to Lux, matching win[4-6] on disk. Spikes: Akshan's early swing trades, level 6 Comeuppance (100s at rank 1, 2500 range), Lux's first-item root conversion, late range war.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit from attacks and abilities, and Lucent Singularity's zone reveals him out of Going Rogue camouflage.
audit.why: The shield eats the front of your burst, so the third-hit proc has to be spent before you commit; the reveal is the direct answer to the roam pattern the lane is built on.
audit.corrected: tradeGood now calls for making him spend Dirty Fighting; ahead and dosFull[1].d name the E reveal against Going Rogue.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing 18s at rank 1 over 800 range, Avengerang 9s at rank 1, Comeuppance 100s at rank 1 reaching 2500 units.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Akshan wins by swinging in on Heroic Swing, eating your burst with Dirty Fighting's third-hit shield, then executing you low with Comeuppance.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: E him as he winds up, detonate, weave the passive auto, keep Q loaded — Dirty Fighting shields on every third hit, so make him spend it first.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Q-poking on cooldown, then facing a swing-in with the root down — Heroic Swing crosses 800 units and you own nothing else that stops it.

edits.before: Ahead, own the geometry: E Akshan off every contact, root the answers, and laser the river fights from fog — fed Lux turns vision lines into kill lines.
edits.after: Ahead, own the geometry: E him off every contact, root the swing, and hunt his Going Rogue lines — your E zone reveals the camouflage roam.

edits.before: E-poke from max range on his last-hits — the slow zone plus passive auto is your chip engine from level 1.
edits.after: Dirty Fighting's extra shot out-trades your poke at level 1 — hold E for the wave, not for him yet.

edits.before: Q joins: the root threat re-prices every step he takes past the wave's midline.
edits.after: Heroic Swing online at 18s — he swings in, trades, and leaves before your Q lands.

edits.after: His swing trade plus roam threat keeps him ahead; shield the follow-up auto and reset the wave.
